Bill.BriefDescription: Increasing the criminal penalty for making unlicensed small loans.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to increasing the criminal penalty for makingunlicensed small loans; amending RCW 31.45.180; and prescribingpenalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 31.45.180 and 1994 c 92 s 290 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person who violates or participates in the violation of anyprovision of the rules or orders of the director or any provision ofthis chapter, except RCW 31.45.105(1)(d), is guilty of a misdemeanor. (2) Any person who violates or participates in the violation of anyprovision of RCW 31.45.105(1)(d) is guilty of a class B felony.
